text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season has arrived once again.
However, this year is slightly different from the last.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...! You're running in the Breeders' Cup
this autumn, right?! G-Good luck!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
! ...Fufu♪ Thank you so much.
I'll do my best to get great results♡

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Looks like I'll need to fire myself up even more.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey lady... I know I asked for a large portion, but...
isn't this... freakishly huge...?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
You're entering a big race in America, right?
Eat a mega-portion and build up your body so you don't lose out to the power of the girls over there!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious... but... there's so much!
B-But this, too, is a trial...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Feeling people's expectations, as long as it's not over the top, is pretty much all upside.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It's called the Pygmalion effect.
Our stats are gonna shoot up even more♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's get pumped and go for it!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's all get hyped up!
After all, it's summer☆
